s.how: Boil 20 frozen pierogi, drain and pan-fry in 40g butter with 2 sliced onions until golden. Serve with 150g sour cream. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Toss 400g raw peanuts with 3 tbsp honey, 20g melted butter and 1 tsp salt. Roast at 170C for 15 minutes, stirring twice, then cool on the tray so they crisp up.

m.how: Grill 8 frankfurts and serve in 8 buns with spicy brown mustard and diced onion. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Toss 800g pitted cherries with 120g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour. Fill a 23cm pastry case, top with a lattice and bake at 190C for 45 minutes. Serve with ice cream.

d.n: A shot of rum for Jobu
d.how: Pour 30ml dark rum into 4 small glasses, plus one for Jobu. Cola for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
